name: Mosaic Court
summary: An enclosing courtyard mosque wraps around a single eight-point star set into its raised court.
why: The perimeter roof forms one closed ring with a genuine central opening. The star uses the same projected floor axes as the building, and sits at z=6 beneath the z=8 roof. A short minaret joins the left wing, while a dome sits directly on the rear prayer hall.
risk: The inner star becomes a small diamond-like paving accent at 24 pixels. The enclosing courtyard and low architectural mass remain the primary silhouette.
sub2: Islamic craft built into the architecture
reasonToChoose: You want an architectural mosque identity with visible depth and a distinct courtyard silhouette.
